items.title: Is IBM Stock A Buy After Missing On Transaction Processing?
items.summary: International Business Machines (IBM) has given back 12.9% over the past three months and sits at $239.94, about 73% of its 52-week high. Management sees no evidence of clients moving off the mainframe. What has changed is that a key slice of IBM’s transactional software revenue rides on a purchase those clients have learned they can postpone.

items.title: Stocks to Watch Thursday: Apple, Oracle, TSMC
items.summary: ↗️ Apple (AAPL): Shares were up nearly 3% in early afternoon trading, a day after it introduced its first-ever foldable iPhone at a product event that also featured Apple’s new CEO, John Ternus. 🔎 Oracle (ORCL): The database and cloud-computing company is set to report earnings after markets close, an update that could provide insight into its push to become a major infrastructure provider for OpenAI.
